verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sabadh surat liv saadh sa(n)g ulaT pavan man meen kee chapal hai ||

en.bdb: Practicing Naam Simran in the holy congregation, the wind-like frolicsome mind who is very swift like a fish reaches the tenth mystical door where he engrosses himself in perpetual union of words and consciousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪ ਚੀਨੀਅਤ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: soha(n) so ajapaa jaap cheeneeat aapaa aap unamanee jot ko udhot hui prabal hai ||

en.bdb: And likewise, due to the philosopher-stone like perpetual meditation that he remains engrossed in without any conscious effort, he becomes aware of himself. In the state when the mind is God-oriented, the bright effulgence of the Lord's name appears.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਰੁਨ ਝੁਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰਨਿ ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: anahadh naadh bisamaadh run jhun sun nijhar jharan barakhaa a(n)mirat jal hai ||

en.bdb: This state of strong God-oriented refulgence, he hears the melodious tunes of the unstruck music and remains in a state of trance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਲ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੧॥
verses.translit_en: anabhai abhiaas ko pragaas asacharaj mai bisam bisavaiaas baas braham sathal hai ||251||

en.bdb: This experience that is felt in the tenth opening of the body, its radiance is astonishing and full of ecstasy. The stay of the mind in the mystical tenth door is of strange faith. (251)
